source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Whenever a **NECRONS** model of yours, other than a **MONSTER** model, attacks a unit in range of an objective marker, the attack gets +1 to [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls). Ranged weapons of your **NECRONS VEHICLE** and **NECRONS MOUNTED** models, other than **TITANIC** models, also get **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)**.
